Cats for Companion Dogs, in eleven coats: black, white, orange, calico, tuxedo, brown tabby, grey tabby, orange tabby, barley, cow and tortoiseshell. A cat is a lookout. It won't fight the dead, it won't work your livestock and it won't breed with a dog. It notices zombies further out than any dog in the mod and stays quiet about it, it goes hunting while you sleep and leaves what it caught at your feet, and its Cat's Eyes moodle keeps the dark from cutting your night foraging down to arm's length. It takes rodents and rabbits, leaves deer alone, and your own chickens and cows are never prey. The catch is that it is the most stubborn animal in the family, its loyalty fades faster than a dog's if you neglect it, and every so often it spots a rat, drops everything and goes after it until it is done. Strays turn up in houses, shops and pet stores, with their own spawn multiplier in the sandbox options, and the coat you find is luck. REQUIRES the Companion Dogs mod, version 0.7.0 or newer. Removing it means removing the whole thing, and the wiki has the procedure: https://companiondogs.pet/docs/en/features.html#23-removing-the-mod-from-a-save-read-this-first

Tame a stray dog and raise a loyal companion that follows you, warns of zombies, and fights at your side, but every advantage has a price. Built for Build 42 (42.18+); works in singleplayer, co-op and dedicated servers and is safe to add to existing saves. ALPHA: five breeds so far (the Brazilian street mutt Caramelo, the German Shepherd, the Golden Retriever, the rare winter Husky and the Border Collie farm dog) plus breeding with puppies, assisted hunting, cargo saddlebags and livestock care, with more breeds and vet care on the roadmap. Obedience unlocks a trick tree: go to a spot (level 1), distract zombies (level 3), sniff out an item (level 5) and fetch it while you sleep (level 10); an untrained dog can also ignore an order, which sandbox can switch off. Multiplayer: on a co-op host, enable Companion Dogs in the main-menu Mods list (not just the in-game co-op selection) or the dog appears without its model/texture; on dedicated servers each player just needs it enabled. Chinese (简体/繁體) translation by duwenju1203. Italian translation by d4rk83 and Daniel. Japanese and Spanish translations by 一匹狼. Thai translation by momineko. Russian translation by Jackson WalWhite and MechJeb2. Ukrainian translation by MechJeb2. Korean translation by Hagaren. Vietnamese translation by huuhoa43. German translation by Katinka1988. French translation by lordtmk. ASSET USAGE: feel free to build add-ons and new breeds for Companion Dogs and to use the mod's art in them, just give proper credit; outside of that, please do not extract, repackage or redistribute the mod's content in unrelated projects without explicit permission.

Chihuahuas for Companion Dogs - a tiny, nervous city dog with sharp senses and a huge attitude. It learns Obedience quickly, gains Combat experience slowly, senses zombies 15% earlier than other breeds, and gives the Keen Eye / Ojo al detalle mood while nearby, fed and loyal, adding +1 Search Mode forage vision. It can attack and help knock zombies down, but normally cannot finish zombies on its own. Rare spawns: homes, urban shops, pet shops, vets, hair salons, barber shops, beauty salons, spas and a small extra urban roll in Louisville. Includes its own model, portrait, puppy support, breeding compatibility and Chihuahua voice set. Easter egg: a female Chihuahua named Chita becomes much stronger while she keeps that name. REQUIRES Companion Dogs. Safe for single player and multiplayer. Do not remove this add-on from a save with living Chihuahuas.

Dobermans for Companion Dogs - a gunfighter's dog. It trains for the fight as fast as the German Shepherd and the Rottweiler, but what sets it apart is the steepest lethality curve in the mod: weak while untrained, deadlier than any other breed once fully trained, and it soaks up less punishment than a Rottweiler. Comes with its own Steady Aim moodle - your firearm accuracy, recoil recovery and reload speed all improve while your Doberman is at your side. Stray Dobermans guard police stations and military checkpoints, and very rarely turn up at a house. REQUIRES the Companion Dogs mod (0.6.3 or newer). Do not remove this add-on from a save with living Dobermans.

Labrador Retrievers for Companion Dogs - a hunting dog built to bring it back. The Labrador trains Hunting twice as fast, with Obedience close behind, and it is one of the worst fighters in the family by design: only the Pug bites weaker, no knockdown, and it stresses badly in a brawl. Its gift is its mouth. With the Soft Mouth moodle a Labrador brings its kills back to you from the moment it can hunt, instead of waiting for a high Hunting skill, never drops one on the way, and often turns up with something else it found - and while it is at your side you learn Butchering and Short Blade faster. Stray Labradors are common in homes and turn up around hunting cabins, campsites, boathouses and ranger stations. REQUIRES the Companion Dogs mod (0.6.6 or newer). Do not remove this add-on from a save with living Labradors.

Adds Pomeranians to Companion Dogs: a small, bright and watchful breed with its own model, portrait, sounds, puppies, breeding support, saddlebags and the unique mood "You Think You're Bigger Than You Are". Includes English, Spanish and Portuguese. REQUIRES Companion Dogs. Safe for single player and multiplayer. Do not remove this add-on from a save with living Pomeranians.

Pugs for Companion Dogs - the house dog, and the first companion in the family whose worth is not fighting, hunting, herding or hauling. A Pug trains Obedience twice as fast as any other breed and its bond never fades on its own, so it stays reliable however long you have been gone. It spots trouble sooner than the rest and barks about it, which warns you and the dead alike, and it is the only dog stuck on Alert: no Quiet, no Silent watch. Everything else is the price: the weakest bite in the family, no kills, no knockdowns, the first to panic, no keeping up at a sprint, almost nothing carried, and real suffering in summer heat. With the Your Shadow moodle it drives off unhappiness, boredom and stress faster than any other dog, until the heat leaves it panting. Stray Pugs are common in homes and turn up at pet shops and veterinary clinics. REQUIRES the Companion Dogs mod (0.7.0 or newer). Do not remove this add-on from a save with living Pugs.

Rottweilers for Companion Dogs - the first optional breed add-on. A combat-category dog: a fearless warrior on par with the German Shepherd, with its own Front Line moodle (your melee swings cost less endurance while your Rottweiler fights beside you). Stray Rottweilers guard warehouses, factories and junkyards, with a rare chance in homes. REQUIRES the Companion Dogs mod (0.6.3 or newer). Do not remove this add-on from a save with living Rottweilers.

HydeCo. Beavers! Live beavers and 167 beaver lodges in the wild rivers, creeks, lakes and ponds of Kentucky, with gnawed stumps and sticks on the banks: out from dusk to dawn, and when you come close they swim out, slap their tails and dive. Sneak up to get closer. Butchered, one gives meat, a pelt, its tail and two teeth.
HydeCo. Bees! Build 42 adds wild and cultivated beekeeping, hive smoking, queen rearing, wax crafting, resin repairs, mead brewing, cheese, preservation, and more.

HydeCo. Frogs! Live green frogs and bullfrogs on the banks of Kentucky's ponds, creeks and rivers, with lily pads on the shallows: always one about near water, far more on warm nights and in the rain. Walk up on one and it leaps into the water and sinks; sneak up to get closer. Caught by hand or butchered for a frog.

HydeCo. Robins! Live American robins hopping and pecking on Kentucky's lawns and fields by day, living in nest trees that drop feathers and, now and then, a nest or eggs. Walk up on one and it takes off into its tree; sneak up to get closer. A stick trap catches one alive; butchered, one gives small-bird meat and feathers.
HydeCo. Squirrels! Live grey and fox squirrels that den in Kentucky's trees: watch them forage, chase them up their den trees, fell the tree to catch one, or trap them alive.
HydeCo. Knox Underground! Sewers under the manholes, caves under dry wells, and a pick to dig your own way down: mining, ores, blasting, bad air and cave life.

A generator powers the whole building it reaches, not just a circle of tiles. Lights, fridges, stoves, televisions and washers come on across every floor, the roof and the basement, and the generator burns fuel for all of it. Two generators split the bill instead of doubling it, and a breaker trips if you overload one. Feed a generator from a barrel standing beside it, or from your whole base's gasoline with LG Extended Plumbing installed. Safe to add mid-save. To remove it, switch it off and restart once first. Barrels go anywhere: on the roof they feed every floor below for free, and a generator on a barrel's square pushes water up as well. A tap reads all of them added up and they drain together. Run iron pipe out to a shed, a yard or the house next door and they all share one supply. Right-click a fixture to pick which liquid it draws, and run whiskey, beer or milk to it instead. Water dispensers plumb in the other way around, to be kept full from the supply. Safe to add mid-save. Before removing it, run Uninstall from the debug menu. Appliances draw what they really draw. The game gives every appliance of a kind the same number, and it is the most it could ever draw rather than what it really uses - a fridge is billed 1300 watts around the clock when its compressor runs a few minutes an hour. Worse, a big appliance is billed once for every tile it covers, so one large store fridge costs 2600 watts. I rate every appliance once, at what it actually uses over time, and tell a mini fridge apart from a walk-in cooler. Needs LG Extended Electricity. Safe to add or remove mid-save. Singleplayer, hosted multiplayer and dedicated server.

Companion fix for [B42]PROJECT RV Interior. RV cabins are built from plain map tiles far outside the normal playable area, with no roof geometry for the engine's room detection to find - so every interior is permanently classed as outdoors. Rain always gets you wet inside, and cabin temperature always followed raw outdoor weather too, worst during rain (the base mod even has code to fill rain collectors placed inside the room, which is the same bug working as intended from its point of view). This mod always keeps you dry inside any RV interior, and - if the RV has a real, switched-on, powered Heater part (the same one behind the driver-seat radial toggle, doubling as AC) - pulls your temperature toward what that heater/AC is actually set to. No heater, heater off, or no battery charge means no correction: a desert-parked RV with the AC off still cooks you, a snowed-in one with no heater still freezes you. Adds a context-menu option to toggle that heater/AC from inside the interior, since the normal driver-seat toggle is unreachable once teleported in. Optional sandbox toggle (EnableCabinClimateControl, default on) turns the whole temperature behaviour off, leaving only the wetness fix. Two more issues (a tile bug in the school bus back seat row that blocks movement and disassembly, and odd furniture placement) are recorded in NOTES.md for a follow-up version. Requires PROJECT RV Interior. Load after it.

Adds archery to Project Zomboid Build 42: seven bows (three carved bows crafted with the Carving skill, two built up from parts and unlocked by the Fletching skill, and two loot-only compound bows, each in eight colours - 21 bow items in all) and ten arrows, most of them crafted from parts under a custom Fletching skill: a shaft carved from real wood, fletching cut from feathers, cards or plastic bottles, and a head knapped from flint, carved from bone, cut from scrap, welded or forged - or, at the top end, a manufactured carbon shaft fitted with a machined head, both scavenged rather than made. Bows train a custom ten-level Archery skill instead of Aiming, show the nocked arrow in your hands, and sling across your back like a rifle. Pick the arrow you want from the reload radial, tap-R or the right-click menu, and the bow remembers it. Arrows you hit a zombie with have a chance to survive and lodge in the body, so you recover them by looting the corpse and ammunition is something you go and retrieve - a failed roll breaks the arrow rather than destroying it, and a broken arrow can be repaired. Build an Archery Target to practise on: it trains Archery, and the arrows you land stick out of its face for you to pull back out. An in-game Archery Handbook explains every system and lists every item, with the stats read live out of the mod so they are never out of date. A Leather Quiver - sewn, or looted in brown, gray or green - wears on the hip, accepts arrows and nothing else, and shows the bundle you are actually carrying on your character - un-nocking a bow returns the arrow to it. Holding a drawn bow tires your arms, scaled to the bow's draw weight and eased by your Archery level rather than by Aiming, with a sandbox slider of its own. Ships with 30 custom bow animation clips covering idle, movement, crouch, eight-way strafing, raising and lowering the bow, aim, draw, release and limping on an injured leg, which hold their own alongside other animation mods - with Lethal Stealth installed the bow gets its own prone and crawling poses, and Fancy Handwork and Brutal Hands keep posing your hands. Multiplayer is supported. Available in English, French, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese. Fully standalone - no dependencies. Archery and Fletching skill books, The American Bowyer recipe magazines, bow repair and sandbox loot sliders are in, and reload speed scales with your Archery level. Suggestions are genuinely welcome, and bug reports get fixed as fast as I can manage - please report anything you find rather than uninstalling over it.
